checks.name: Player B/N brief and live next action explain real responsibilities; saved guidance off is respected

actual.bnBrief:
Your job: bombardier/navigator. The pilot launches, flies and lands. You manage navigation and the mission tasks below.
1. Read CHART; slew onto each checkpoint return and LOCK for a navigation fix. 2. Identify the briefed target and LOCK; STEER sends the pilot toward your crosshairs. On offset attacks, LOCK the landmark twice; on blind attacks, LOCK the coordinate ring. 3. Hold Space / COMMIT through the cleared bomb solution. 4. Release after bombs away; monitor navigation, fuel and recovery.
Holding bomb consent also sets MASTER ARM; letting go returns SAFE. Emergency: J ejects both seats.

cue.title: B/N · pilot flies
cue.text: The existing pilot handles power, launch and flying. You: fix navigation, identify + LOCK; hold Space / COMMIT for bombs. First: M / CHART for the route.

cue.title: B/N · take a radar fix
cue.text: COAST-IN 275° · 5.1 NM · SYS ERR 306 yd. Tab / SCOPE: X + arrows onto real return; Enter / LOCK for a fix, not a target designation. C / STEER points pilot at crosshairs.
